summary: Ithaca Tompkins Regional Airport serves the city of Ithaca, New York, home to Cornell University and Ithaca College, situated in the scenic Finger Lakes region. The single-terminal facility completed a major modernization and expansion project in 2019, significantly upgrading passenger amenities. It functions as a vital regional link for one of New York's most renowned college towns.
